Upper Text: ＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost)
[On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a level 5 or lower Digimon card with ＜Fortitude＞, play it without paying the cost. Add the rest to the hand.
[Your Turn] All your Digimon with ＜Fortitude＞ and no digivolution cards gain ＜Rush＞.
